rule: Every ledger/items/*.yml with status: DONE must carry a guard: block (kind/ref/asserts/provenRed, see ledger/README.md) that scripts/quality/check-done-item-guards.py can verify RESOLVES -- a real test method, a real script/gradle-test-class, or (for kind: manual) a real repo-rooted path if one is named at all. A DONE claim with no guard is an assertion, not a proof.
why: R11 (strategy-2026-08-12/ROADMAP.md): measured at card-authoring time, 178/178 tracked items were DONE, 154 claimed verification: VERIFIED_LIVE, and nothing anywhere re-tested any of them. Re-measured 2026-08-14 against the live ledger at the time this checker landed: 226 items, 195 DONE, and only 15 of those 195 carried a guard: block despite the field existing since 992d47a8. This policy freezes the 177 DONE-without-guard items that predate the checker (195 DONE minus the 3 backfilled in the same commit that added this file -- REG-142, REG-108, STOR-2, proving the ratchet resolves a real test, a real script, and a real script respectively) into a shrink-only legacy list, exactly scripts/policy/doc-inventory-policy.json's pattern pointed at a different quantity: a DONE item filed or re-closed from this commit forward cannot be added to it.

legacy.note: Pre-ratchet DONE items with no guard: block, FROZEN 2026-08-14. This list may only SHRINK -- either by the item genuinely gaining a real guard (remove its id here and lower frozenCount in the same commit) or by the item ceasing to exist / ceasing to be DONE (same). Adding an id here is exactly what this policy exists to stop; check-done-item-guards.py's R1 fails the moment a NEW DONE-without-guard item appears, and its R3 fails the moment a listed id no longer needs the exemption (stale entry, not honestly removed).
